{{Otheruses|Frist}}
'''Frist sharks''' were marine predators from [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. These animals had a row of six fang-like teeth, similar to those of the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]].
